python -c "
import sqlite3, io
c=sqlite3.connect('D:/github/miniBot/data/memes.db')
cur=c.cursor()
cur.execute('select tag,length(tag) from meme_tags order by length(tag) desc')
rows=cur.fetchall()
out=io.open('D:/github/miniBot/data/workspace/main/tag_report.txt','w',encoding='utf-8')
out.write('长句标签（长度>=4）共 %d 个：\n' % sum(1 for t,l in rows if l>=4))
for t,l in rows:
    if l>=4:
        out.write('  [%d字] %s\n' % (l,t))
out.write('\n全部标签共 %d 个：\n' % len(rows))
for t,l in rows:
    out.write('  [%d] %s\n' % (l,t))
out.close()
print('done')
"
